Escape the metropolitan and go back to the roots in a rustic & homely environment. The best place to have fabulous evenings.Known for serving south Indian traditional food in Ahmedabad, Sambar Cafe has been nominated for the best authentic south Indian restaurant in Ahmedabad for the last two years in Times Food & Nightlife Awards 2022. Made with the best possible culinary skills and authentic taste, each dish is flavourful and mouth-watering. All ingredients are sourced from different parts of south India to create luscious delicacies for providing you with the pure experience of an authentic south Indian food restaurant in Ahmedabad.

At Sambar Cafe, our goal is to provide an enjoyable dining experience from the first to the last bite. We are committed to delivering a meal that is fresh, delicious, and satisfying. Whether you’re planning for an intimate evening or family dinner, you’ll experience flavourful south Indian meals in Ahmedabad. You’ll find a vast menu that appeals to any taste or choice.

Though Sambar Cafe is one of the best authentic south Indian restaurants in Ahmedabad, this iconic restaurant is not just popular for the best dosa in Ahmedabad. At Sambar Cafe, you’ll have a lot to choose from. Be it Paniyaram, Appam with Kadala Curry, Thayir Vada, Idiyappam with Stew, Lemon Sevai, Tomato Sevai, Hot Filter Coffee, and other mouth-watering South Indian dishes, our restaurant serves all. Along with dining service, we provide delivery as well. So, you can enjoy delicious south Indian meals in Ahmedabad anywhere.

As a leading authentic South Indian restaurant, Sambar Cafe is the perfect place to enjoy your breakfast with nature. All our meals are prepared by our highly efficient professionals with no fussy preparation and served at the best price possible. We support and nurture our team members to give their best and evolve professionally. Our vision is to gain your trust with our hard work, dedication and utmost service.

THE PROMOTER
JAYANTI SANTOSH

Jayanti Santosh is a passionate entrepreneur and a food enthusiast. Born in a Palakkad Iyer family, she has been living in Ahmedabad since the last 30 years. While bringing a wide selection of unknown South Indian dishes, she has also curated various masalas & powders to serve the discerning palate of an Amdavadi.

OUR PHILOSOPHY
A desire to serve authentic south Indian food to the food loving people of Ahmedabad.
Right from thoughtfully sourcing of all the ingredients to the end product, to give our best of the south Indian cuisine to the customers.
Each dish to be curated with the best possible culinary skills and awesome authentic flavour & taste.
